finding.text: Only the `pages` half of the bug is fixed; the `content` half the brief names still writes. I ran it on a temp page in the worktree: `item({delta:{"content":{"text":"x"}}})` and `{"content":{"nope":{"text":"x"}}}` (a card id that doesn't exist) both answer `ok:true` and append a line to page.jsonl. The fix belongs in the write path near `Servex/agents/page_tools.js:1554`, plus a test for each case.

Deliverables 1 and 2 left no record. The task's session.jsonl holds only the assign line and two commit lines: no logged repro delta, no "cause at file:line" line, no closing report saying "needs a Servex restart to go live". A fresh agent can't continue from this folder. The cause is only written up in code comments (`page_tools.js:418-421`), and it differs from the brief (the line was silently dropped with `ok:true, line:null`, not written), so that finding has to go in the task record.

`page_tools.js:462` `const PAGE_PRELOADED = await page_class()` turns a lazy import into a top-level await. Every process that imports page_tools.js (Servex, `Server/AskIndex.mjs:192`, `Server/JsonlPerf.mjs:58`) now loads Page.class.js and registers the site-hooks resolve hook at import time, even if it never touches a page. It works (the tests pass), but it is a side effect worth a sentence in `Servex/doc/item-tool.md`. The other option was to warm the class lazily on the first item() call and run `record_lines` unchecked until then.

Scope grew past the brief: commit 1b96f4c4f also adds `bad_page_delta` to `record_lines` (`page_tools.js:1362-1371`), which is the path for browser-tab posts and append.mjs, not only the item() tool. It's in the fence and tested, including that LivePage kinds still pass (`item_tool.test.mjs`, the "-live-page" fixture), but the brief asked for one fix on the write path. Say so in the report.

The brief asked for one doc line. `Servex/doc/item-tool.md:50` is one long paragraph, and it carries history ("used to skip…", "2026-11-06, item-validate"), which readme rule 9 keeps out of docs. It also never mentions the new `pages` refusal from 9ccf4eba0. Suggested wording: "a `pages` key other than add/rename/remove/promote is refused by name; a raw page line gets the same `bad_page_delta` check".
`page_tools.js:417`: the older message "`pages` must be {add|rename|remove: …}" leaves out `promote`, which the new message on line 423 includes.
Tests pass in the worktree: `item_tool: 125 checks passed`, `page_tools: 40 checks passed`. Commits: 1b96f4c4f, 9ccf4eba0, then the merge f56b3c78b.
